plugins.name: claude
plugins.description: Claude Code hooks: one task per Claude session; prompt -> working, permission or question -> waiting_user, turn end -> review, API error -> failed.
plugins.author: T-Agent

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Sends T-Attention messages and rings a call from your Telegram account 1 to account 2 (MTProto user API).
plugins.author: T-Agent

plugins.name: email
plugins.description: Sends T-Attention messages by email from your own mailbox over SMTP (Gmail and 163 Mail built in, or any SMTP server).
plugins.author: T-Agent

plugins.name: widget
plugins.description: Shows T-Attention messages as a bubble beside the T-Attention desktop window on this Mac. Click the bubble to open its link.
plugins.author: T-Agent
